name: Peel Back the Layers
why_it_works: Each swipe removes one cover and shows a little more, so the reader keeps swiping to finish the picture. Carousels that hold attention across every slide get shown to more people, and the full reveal on the last slide rewards the effort.

hook.pattern: First slide is almost fully covered, with one tiny visible corner and the line 'swipe to uncover'.
examples: Something new from {{brand}}. Swipe to uncover it.
You can see one corner. Can you guess the rest?
Five swipes until you see it. No skipping.

variables.name: layer_three
variables.description: Third hint (the story or who made it), lowercase, reads after 'It's', 8 words or fewer
variables.example: cut and sewn in our own studio

slides.headline: Swipe to uncover it
slides.body: Something new from {{brand}}. One corner is all you get.
slides.visual_prompt: 4:5 frame almost fully covered by heavy paper, a small torn corner showing a sliver of the {{product}}, soft studio light

slides.headline: Layer one: {{layer_one}}
slides.visual_prompt: Paper torn back a third of the way, revealing {{layer_one}} texture in close-up, soft studio light

slides.headline: Layer two: {{layer_two}}
slides.visual_prompt: Paper torn halfway, showing {{layer_two}} in macro detail, same light and angle

slides.headline: Layer three
slides.visual_prompt: Paper mostly torn away, the {{product}} nearly visible, silhouette clear, same angle

slides.headline: Ready?
slides.visual_prompt: Single torn paper scrap in the center of a blank colored backdrop in {{brand}} colors

slides.headline: Meet the {{product}}
slides.visual_prompt: The full {{product}} revealed, hero shot, clean backdrop, soft key light, 4:5

slides.headline: Drops {{launch_date}}
slides.body: Save this so you don't miss it.
slides.visual_prompt: {{brand}} logo and the launch date in large type over a blurred version of the hero shot

cta: Save this post and set a reminder: {{product}} drops {{launch_date}}.

craft.notes: Keep the camera angle and light identical on every slide so the only change is how much is uncovered. Each slide's hint should be a sense (texture, color, sound, origin), not a sales claim.

do_not: Reveal the full product before the last two slides
Change the framing between slides; the reader loses the thread
Use for a product that looks ordinary once revealed
compliance: Skincare: cosmetic claims only (looks, feels); no claims that it heals, treats or cures anything
Skincare: no before/after skin images unless they are real, consenting customers with a 'results vary' note
Label AI-generated product or texture images where the platform requires it; the final slide must show the real product
